{"notes": "Visit 4 (ending 6:00). Still don't know who placed which domino; no hands labeled. Picture: one dark chain, all connected, from START across the top, round the nose and left bend, along the bottom line, and now a new tail stretch to ~(17,14.5). No pale dominoes. The doubled/crowded overlap at ~(11-13,15) is still there, but the chain runs through it to the tail, so it hasn't stalled. About 4:00 left.

Maya: Finally heard her. She acknowledged the handoff (tail is Priya's from where her line stops) and said she'd check the belly joins. Good collaboration and clear role ownership, and checking joins is useful. Still can't attribute the belly line to her. Ask privately what she placed and whether she found the overlap.

Leo: Again the clearest coordinator. He told Priya to carry the bottom to the tail, told Maya to stand back, and flagged the jammed domino at the belly overlap with a specific fix (leave from the true end). The tail connected, which is consistent with his advice working. He is watching quality and not just talking. Still ask Priya how his directing sat with her. He hasn't been seen placing anything this visit, but the nose fix earlier counts.

Priya: Not heard. Maya and Leo both name her as the tail builder, and the tail exists, so that probably fits. I haven't seen her place anything. Ask what she built, and whether she knew about the overlap.

Tom: Silent again, clear of the table. Still no observed building and no attributed work. Ask what he did, and don't rate him down only for silence.

For the review, credit only what I saw or what the picture and several accounts agree on. Leo is strongest on evidence. Maya is improving. Priya and Tom need first-hand accounts."}
